findings.description: User input for `roundFileName` is directly used in `Path.Combine` without validation
Hardcoded absolute paths expose system information
Generic error handling might expose sensitive information through exceptions
No validation on user inputs for file names or menu choices
Hardcoded file paths should be configurable
